That setting puts raccoons, gray squirrels, bats, striped skunks in regular contact with homes here, and most jobs start with a full roofline and foundation inspection, then removal and sealing every entry we find. Every operator we send is a WVDNR-licensed Wildlife Damage Control Agent (WDCA), and we handle disposition the West Virginia way — exclusion and on-site liberation where the rules allow it, never a relocation promise.

Spring is denning season here, summer is bat season in the older housing stock, and fall brings a second push as squirrels and rodents look for winter shelter.
